# Extended_Memory_Retrieval

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
The capability of a gated associative memory network to retrieve stored patterns beyond classical capacity limits or under noisy or partial cues. Improves robustness and storage efficiency for neuromorphic in-network memory applications.
